### Haymaker (G4 — *Friendship Is Magic*)
Haymaker is the **elderly pegasus trainer/massage pony attending Spitfire** at the Wonderbolts’ camp in *Rainbow Falls*. He has a **pale cream coat, white mane, light-blue eyes**, and a **red boxing/wrestling bell cutie mark**. His gruff-old-boxing-coach look recalls **Mickey Goldmill from *Rocky***; that is a visual comparison, not a confirmed creator statement. [Character and appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Elders).

- **Name:** **Haymaker** is a **licensed-merchandise name**, established on Enterplay’s *The Crystal Games* card **#48 R, “Haymaker, Tough Trainer”** (also listed as a Pegasus/Elder). It is **not a name spoken in the episode**. [Enterplay official card reference](https://www.enter-play.com/products/MLP_CCG_OCR_9.1.pdf).
- **Appearance:** *Rainbow Falls*, **season 4, episode 10** (first aired **January 18, 2014**); he gives Spitfire a massage during the Equestria Games qualifying practices. No additional screen appearance was verified. [Episode listing](https://www.tvmaze.com/episodes/204939/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-4x10-rainbow-falls).
- **Speaking:** **No credited dialogue or identifiable voice actor** in the television episode. Motivational lines attributed to him on trading cards are **card flavor text**, not verified spoken dialogue. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Rainbow_Falls).
